maddeler.e:
نتكاسل (form VI)
# نَتَكَاسَلُ (natakāsalu) /na.ta.kaː.sa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَاسَلَ (takāsala)
# نَتَكَاسَلَ (natakāsala) /na.ta.kaː.sa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَاسَلَ (takāsala)
# نَتَكَاسَلْ (natakāsal) /na.ta.kaː.sal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَاسَلَ (takāsala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
